**********************************************************************
* Dynamic function-module call.
**********************************************************************
CLASS zcl_fs_slc_gw_func DEFINITION
  PUBLIC
  ABSTRACT
  FINAL.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    "! Builds the parameter binding without calling anything.
    CLASS-METHODS prepare
      IMPORTING is_reg  TYPE zfs_t_slc_dyngw
                is_step TYPE zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>ty_step
      EXPORTING es_plan TYPE zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>ty_fm_plan
                es_out  TYPE zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>ty_outcome.

    "! Runs a prepared call and collects EXPORTING / CHANGING / TABLES.
    CLASS-METHODS execute
      IMPORTING is_plan       TYPE zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>ty_fm_plan
      RETURNING VALUE(rs_out) TYPE zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>ty_outcome.

    "! BAPI_TRANSACTION_COMMIT on the shared DESTINATION 'NONE' session.
    CLASS-METHODS commit
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_ok) TYPE abap_bool.

    "! BAPI_TRANSACTION_ROLLBACK on the shared DESTINATION 'NONE' session.
    CLASS-METHODS rollback.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS resolve_mode
      IMPORTING is_reg         TYPE zfs_t_slc_dyngw
                iv_fm          TYPE zfs_t_slc_dyngw-target_name
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_mode) TYPE zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>ty_mode.

    CLASS-METHODS bind_group
      IMPORTING it_comp TYPE abap_component_tab
                iv_kind TYPE abap_func_parmbind-kind
                iv_json TYPE string OPTIONAL
      EXPORTING er_data TYPE REF TO data
      CHANGING  ct_ptab TYPE abap_func_parmbind_tab.

ENDCLASS.


CLASS zcl_fs_slc_gw_func IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD resolve_mode.
    DATA lv_fmode TYPE tfdir-fmode.

    IF is_reg-call_mode CA 'RL'.
      rv_mode = is_reg-call_mode.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    SELECT SINGLE fmode FROM tfdir WHERE funcname = @iv_fm INTO @lv_fmode.
    rv_mode = COND #( WHEN lv_fmode = 'R'
                      THEN zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>c_mode-rfc
                      ELSE zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>c_mode-local ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD bind_group.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <ls_struct> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lv_any>    TYPE any.
    DATA lr_field TYPE REF TO data.

    CLEAR er_data.
    IF it_comp IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_str) = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( it_comp ).
    CREATE DATA er_data TYPE HANDLE lo_str.
    ASSIGN er_data->* TO <ls_struct>.

    IF iv_json IS NOT INITIAL.
      /ui2/cl_json=>deserialize( EXPORTING json = iv_json CHANGING data = <ls_struct> ).
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT it_comp INTO DATA(ls_c).
      ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_c-name OF STRUCTURE <ls_struct> TO <lv_any>.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        CONTINUE.
      ENDIF.
      GET REFERENCE OF <lv_any> INTO lr_field.
      " ABAP_FUNC_PARMBIND_TAB is HASHED - INSERT ... INTO TABLE, never
      " APPEND, which is an index operation and illegal here (L-308).
      INSERT VALUE #( name = ls_c-name kind = iv_kind value = lr_field ) INTO TABLE ct_ptab.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD prepare.
    DATA lt_imp_comp TYPE abap_component_tab.
    DATA lt_chg_comp TYPE abap_component_tab.
    DATA lt_exp_comp TYPE abap_component_tab.
    DATA lt_tab_comp TYPE abap_component_tab.
    DATA lo_type     TYPE REF TO cl_abap_datadescr.
    DATA lr_dummy    TYPE REF TO data.

    CLEAR: es_plan, es_out.
    es_plan-fm = is_step-targetname.

    SELECT SINGLE funcname FROM tfdir WHERE funcname = @es_plan-fm INTO @DATA(lv_found).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR lv_found IS INITIAL.
      es_out = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>fail( iv_number = '019' iv_v1 = |{ es_plan-fm }| ).
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    SELECT parameter, paramtype, structure, table_of
      FROM fupararef
      WHERE funcname = @es_plan-fm
        AND r3state  = 'A'
      ORDER BY pposition
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_params).

    DATA(lt_sent_imp) = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>json_keys( is_step-importjson ).
    DATA(lt_sent_tab) = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>json_keys( is_step-tablesjson ).

    es_plan-mode = resolve_mode( is_reg = is_reg iv_fm = es_plan-fm ).

    LOOP AT lt_params INTO DATA(ls_p).

      DATA(lv_name) = to_upper( |{ ls_p-parameter }| ).
      DATA(lv_sent) = xsdbool(
        ( ls_p-paramtype = 'T' AND line_exists( lt_sent_tab[ table_line = lv_name ] ) ) OR
        ( ls_p-paramtype <> 'T' AND line_exists( lt_sent_imp[ table_line = lv_name ] ) ) ).

      DATA(lo_line) = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>descr_for( ls_p-structure ).
      IF lo_line IS NOT BOUND.
        " Generic (CLIKE / ANY / untyped) or unresolvable: it can never be
        " instantiated, so it cannot be bound. Silently dropping a parameter
        " the caller actually sent would change the callee's behaviour behind
        " their back, so that case is an error, not a skip (L-311).
        IF lv_sent = abap_true.
          es_out = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>fail(
                     iv_number = '020'
                     iv_v1     = |{ es_plan-fm }|
                     iv_v2     = |parameter { ls_p-parameter } is generic| &&
                                 | ({ ls_p-structure }) and cannot be bound dynamically| ).
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.
        CONTINUE.
      ENDIF.

      lo_type = lo_line.
      IF ls_p-table_of = abap_true OR ls_p-paramtype = 'T'.
        TRY.
            lo_type = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lo_line ).
          CATCH cx_sy_table_creation.
            CONTINUE.
        ENDTRY.
      ENDIF.

      CASE ls_p-paramtype.

        WHEN 'I'.
          " The FM's IMPORTING side: we EXPORT to it. Bind only what the
          " caller actually sent.
          IF lv_sent = abap_true.
            APPEND VALUE #( name = ls_p-parameter type = lo_type ) TO lt_imp_comp.
          ENDIF.

        WHEN 'C'.
          IF lv_sent = abap_true.
            IF es_plan-mode = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>c_mode-rfc.
              " RFC has no CHANGING. Say so rather than silently dropping it.
              es_out = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>fail(
                         iv_number = '020'
                         iv_v1     = |{ es_plan-fm }|
                         iv_v2     = |CHANGING { ls_p-parameter } needs call_mode L| ).
              RETURN.
            ENDIF.
            APPEND VALUE #( name = ls_p-parameter type = lo_type ) TO lt_chg_comp.
          ENDIF.

        WHEN 'E'.
          APPEND VALUE #( name = ls_p-parameter type = lo_type ) TO lt_exp_comp.

        WHEN 'T'.
          IF lv_sent = abap_true.
            APPEND VALUE #( name = ls_p-parameter type = lo_type ) TO lt_tab_comp.
          ENDIF.

        WHEN OTHERS.
          CONTINUE.

      ENDCASE.
    ENDLOOP.

    TRY.
        bind_group( EXPORTING it_comp = lt_imp_comp
                              iv_kind = abap_func_exporting
                              iv_json = is_step-importjson
                    IMPORTING er_data = lr_dummy
                    CHANGING  ct_ptab = es_plan-ptab ).
        bind_group( EXPORTING it_comp = lt_chg_comp
                              iv_kind = abap_func_changing
                              iv_json = is_step-importjson
                    IMPORTING er_data = es_plan-r_chg
                    CHANGING  ct_ptab = es_plan-ptab ).
        bind_group( EXPORTING it_comp = lt_exp_comp
                              iv_kind = abap_func_importing
                    IMPORTING er_data = es_plan-r_exp
                    CHANGING  ct_ptab = es_plan-ptab ).
        bind_group( EXPORTING it_comp = lt_tab_comp
                              iv_kind = abap_func_tables
                              iv_json = is_step-tablesjson
                    IMPORTING er_data = es_plan-r_tab
                    CHANGING  ct_ptab = es_plan-ptab ).
      CATCH cx_sy_struct_creation cx_sy_create_data_error.
        es_out = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>fail( iv_number = '020'
                                           iv_v1     = |{ es_plan-fm }|
                                           iv_v2     = |interface could not be built| ).
        RETURN.
      CATCH cx_root.
        es_out = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>fail( iv_number = '022' iv_v1 = |ImportJson/TablesJson| ).
        RETURN.
    ENDTRY.

    INSERT VALUE #( name = 'OTHERS' value = 9 ) INTO TABLE es_plan-etab.
    IF es_plan-mode = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>c_mode-rfc.
      INSERT VALUE #( name = 'SYSTEM_FAILURE'        value = 1 ) INTO TABLE es_plan-etab.
      INSERT VALUE #( name = 'COMMUNICATION_FAILURE' value = 2 ) INTO TABLE es_plan-etab.
    ENDIF.

    es_out-status = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>c_status-ok.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD execute.
    DATA lv_failtext TYPE string.
    DATA lv_exp      TYPE string.
    DATA lv_chg      TYPE string.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <ls_any> TYPE any.

    DATA(lt_ptab) = is_plan-ptab.
    DATA(lt_etab) = is_plan-etab.

    TRY.
        IF is_plan-mode = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>c_mode-rfc.
          " One shared RFC session per request: consecutive calls to the same
          " destination share a LUW, so several BAPIs commit together and a
          " callee that uses update task cannot break the RAP LUW (L-227).
          CALL FUNCTION is_plan-fm
            DESTINATION zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>c_rfc_dest
            PARAMETER-TABLE lt_ptab
            EXCEPTION-TABLE lt_etab.
        ELSE.
          CALL FUNCTION is_plan-fm
            PARAMETER-TABLE lt_ptab
            EXCEPTION-TABLE lt_etab.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_call).
        rs_out = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>fail( iv_number = '020'
                                           iv_v1     = |{ is_plan-fm }|
                                           iv_v2     = lx_call->get_text( ) ).
        RETURN.
    ENDTRY.

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      IF sy-msgid IS NOT INITIAL.
        MESSAGE ID sy-msgid TYPE 'E' NUMBER sy-msgno
          WITH sy-msgv1 sy-msgv2 sy-msgv3 sy-msgv4 INTO lv_failtext.
      ELSE.
        lv_failtext = |exception raised, sy-subrc { sy-subrc }|.
      ENDIF.
      rs_out = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>fail( iv_number = '020'
                                         iv_v1     = |{ is_plan-fm }|
                                         iv_v2     = lv_failtext ).
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rs_out = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>succeed( iv_target = |{ is_plan-fm }| ).

    IF is_plan-r_exp IS BOUND.
      ASSIGN is_plan-r_exp->* TO <ls_any>.
      lv_exp = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>to_json( <ls_any> ).
    ENDIF.
    IF is_plan-r_chg IS BOUND.
      ASSIGN is_plan-r_chg->* TO <ls_any>.
      lv_chg = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>to_json( <ls_any> ).
    ENDIF.
    rs_out-export_json = COND #(
      WHEN lv_chg IS INITIAL THEN lv_exp
      ELSE |\{"EXPORTING":{ COND #( WHEN lv_exp IS INITIAL THEN '{}' ELSE lv_exp ) },| &&
           |"CHANGING":{ lv_chg }\}| ).

    IF is_plan-r_tab IS BOUND.
      ASSIGN is_plan-r_tab->* TO <ls_any>.
      rs_out-tables_json = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>to_json( <ls_any> ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD commit.
    DATA ls_return TYPE bapiret2.
    DATA lv_msg    TYPE c LENGTH 200.

    CALL FUNCTION 'BAPI_TRANSACTION_COMMIT'
      DESTINATION zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>c_rfc_dest
      EXPORTING  wait                  = abap_true
      IMPORTING  return                = ls_return
      EXCEPTIONS system_failure        = 1 MESSAGE lv_msg
                 communication_failure = 2 MESSAGE lv_msg
                 OTHERS                = 3.
    rv_ok = xsdbool( sy-subrc = 0 AND ls_return-type CA ' SI' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD rollback.
    DATA lv_msg TYPE c LENGTH 200.

    CALL FUNCTION 'BAPI_TRANSACTION_ROLLBACK'
      DESTINATION zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>c_rfc_dest
      EXCEPTIONS system_failure        = 1 MESSAGE lv_msg
                 communication_failure = 2 MESSAGE lv_msg
                 OTHERS                = 3.
  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.
table:
**********************************************************************
* Dynamic table write.
**********************************************************************
CLASS zcl_fs_slc_gw_table DEFINITION
  PUBLIC
  ABSTRACT
  FINAL.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS prepare
      IMPORTING is_step TYPE zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>ty_step
      EXPORTING es_plan TYPE zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>ty_tab_plan
                es_out  TYPE zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>ty_outcome.

    CLASS-METHODS execute
      IMPORTING is_plan       TYPE zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>ty_tab_plan
      RETURNING VALUE(rs_out) TYPE zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>ty_outcome.

ENDCLASS.


CLASS zcl_fs_slc_gw_table IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD prepare.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_rows> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.

    CLEAR: es_plan, es_out.
    es_plan-name      = to_upper( |{ is_step-targetname }| ).
    es_plan-operation = to_upper( |{ is_step-operation }| ).

    IF es_plan-operation <> zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>c_op-insert
       AND es_plan-operation <> zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>c_op-modify
       AND es_plan-operation <> zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>c_op-delete.
      es_out = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>fail( iv_number = '018'
                                         iv_v1     = |{ es_plan-operation }|
                                         iv_v2     = es_plan-name ).
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Existence is proven by RTTI, not by trusting the registry row.
    IF zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>descr_for( es_plan-name ) IS NOT BOUND.
      es_out = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>fail( iv_number = '021' iv_v1 = es_plan-name ).
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    TRY.
        CREATE DATA es_plan-r_rows TYPE TABLE OF (es_plan-name).
      CATCH cx_sy_create_data_error.
        es_out = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>fail( iv_number = '021' iv_v1 = es_plan-name ).
        RETURN.
    ENDTRY.
    ASSIGN es_plan-r_rows->* TO <lt_rows>.

    TRY.
        /ui2/cl_json=>deserialize( EXPORTING json = is_step-importjson
                                   CHANGING  data = <lt_rows> ).
      CATCH cx_root.
        es_out = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>fail( iv_number = '022' iv_v1 = 'ImportJson' ).
        RETURN.
    ENDTRY.

    IF <lt_rows> IS INITIAL.
      es_out = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>fail( iv_number = '022' iv_v1 = 'ImportJson' ).
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    es_out-status = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>c_status-ok.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD execute.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_rows> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.

    ASSIGN is_plan-r_rows->* TO <lt_rows>.
    IF <lt_rows> IS NOT ASSIGNED.
      rs_out = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>fail( iv_number = '022' iv_v1 = 'ImportJson' ).
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    CASE is_plan-operation.
      WHEN zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>c_op-insert.
        " ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS turns a duplicate into sy-subrc 4. Without
        " it the statement raises DBSQL_DUPLICATE_KEY_ERROR, an uncatchable
        " short dump that reaches the caller as an empty HTTP 500 (L-312).
        INSERT (is_plan-name) FROM TABLE <lt_rows> ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS.
        IF sy-subrc = 4.
          rs_out = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>fail(
                     iv_number = '020'
                     iv_v1     = is_plan-name
                     iv_v2     = |INSERT: { lines( <lt_rows> ) - sy-dbcnt } of | &&
                                 |{ lines( <lt_rows> ) } row(s) already exist| ).
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.
      WHEN zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>c_op-modify.
        MODIFY (is_plan-name) FROM TABLE <lt_rows>.
      WHEN zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>c_op-delete.
        DELETE (is_plan-name) FROM TABLE <lt_rows>.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rs_out = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>fail( iv_number = '018'
                                           iv_v1     = |{ is_plan-operation }|
                                           iv_v2     = is_plan-name ).
        RETURN.
    ENDCASE.

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      rs_out = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>fail(
                 iv_number = '020'
                 iv_v1     = is_plan-name
                 iv_v2     = |{ is_plan-operation } returned sy-subrc { sy-subrc }| ).
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rs_out = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>succeed( iv_target = is_plan-name iv_count = sy-dbcnt ).
  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.
query:
**********************************************************************
* Dynamic SELECT over a table or CDS view entity.
**********************************************************************
CLASS zcl_fs_slc_gw_query DEFINITION
  PUBLIC
  ABSTRACT
  FINAL.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS prepare
      IMPORTING is_step TYPE zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>ty_step
                is_reg  TYPE zfs_t_slc_dyngw
      EXPORTING es_plan TYPE zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>ty_qry_plan
                es_out  TYPE zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>ty_outcome.

    CLASS-METHODS execute
      IMPORTING is_plan       TYPE zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>ty_qry_plan
      RETURNING VALUE(rs_out) TYPE zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>ty_outcome.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CONSTANTS c_ops      TYPE string VALUE ',EQ,NE,GT,GE,LT,LE,BT,LIKE,IN,'.
    " Kinds whose literals must look numeric / date-like. Feeding one a
    " character literal is the other way to reach an uncatchable SQL dump.
    CONSTANTS c_numeric  TYPE string VALUE 'bsIP8aeF'.
    CONSTANTS c_datetime TYPE string VALUE 'DT'.
    CONSTANTS c_numchars TYPE string VALUE '0123456789.,+- '.

    "! Guards one literal against the column it will be compared with.
    "! Empty result means the value is safe.
    CLASS-METHODS literal_problem
      IMPORTING iv_value      TYPE string
                io_type       TYPE REF TO cl_abap_datadescr
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_why) TYPE string.

ENDCLASS.


CLASS zcl_fs_slc_gw_query IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD literal_problem.
    DATA lo_el TYPE REF TO cl_abap_elemdescr.

    IF iv_value IS INITIAL OR io_type IS NOT BOUND.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    TRY.
        lo_el ?= io_type.
      CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error.
        RETURN.
    ENDTRY.

    " A literal longer than its column terminates the request with
    " SAPSQL_DATA_LOSS, which no TRY/CATCH can intercept - so refuse first
    " (L-310).
    IF lo_el->output_length > 0 AND strlen( iv_value ) > lo_el->output_length.
      rv_why = |value exceeds the length of the field ({ lo_el->output_length })|.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    IF ( c_numeric CS lo_el->type_kind OR c_datetime CS lo_el->type_kind )
       AND iv_value CN c_numchars.
      rv_why = |value is not numeric but the field is|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD prepare.
    DATA lt_fields TYPE zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>tt_name.
    DATA lt_filter TYPE zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>tt_filter.
    DATA lt_order  TYPE zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>tt_order.
    DATA lo_struct TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.
    DATA lo_ftype  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_datadescr.
    DATA lv_frag   TYPE string.
    DATA lv_in     TYPE string.
    DATA lv_why    TYPE string.
    DATA ls_sc     TYPE abap_componentdescr.

    CLEAR: es_plan, es_out.
    es_plan-source = to_upper( |{ is_step-targetname }| ).

    " Row cap: the registry ceiling wins, the caller may only ask for less.
    es_plan-max = COND #( WHEN is_reg-max_rows > 0
                          THEN is_reg-max_rows
                          ELSE zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>c_max_rows_default ).
    IF is_step-maxrows > es_plan-max.
      es_out = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>fail( iv_number = '025'
                                         iv_v1     = |{ is_step-maxrows }|
                                         iv_v2     = |{ es_plan-max }| ).
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.
    IF is_step-maxrows > 0.
      es_plan-max = is_step-maxrows.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_any) = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>descr_for( es_plan-source ).
    IF lo_any IS NOT BOUND.
      es_out = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>fail( iv_number = '021' iv_v1 = es_plan-source ).
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.
    TRY.
        lo_struct ?= lo_any.
      CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error.
        es_out = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>fail( iv_number = '021' iv_v1 = es_plan-source ).
        RETURN.
    ENDTRY.
    DATA(lt_src_comp) = lo_struct->get_components( ).

    TRY.
        IF is_step-fieldsjson IS NOT INITIAL.
          /ui2/cl_json=>deserialize( EXPORTING json = is_step-fieldsjson CHANGING data = lt_fields ).
        ENDIF.
        IF is_step-filterjson IS NOT INITIAL.
          /ui2/cl_json=>deserialize( EXPORTING json = is_step-filterjson CHANGING data = lt_filter ).
        ENDIF.
        IF is_step-orderbyjson IS NOT INITIAL.
          /ui2/cl_json=>deserialize( EXPORTING json = is_step-orderbyjson CHANGING data = lt_order ).
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_root.
        es_out = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>fail( iv_number = '022'
                                           iv_v1     = 'FieldsJson/FilterJson/OrderByJson' ).
        RETURN.
    ENDTRY.

    " ---- projection ------------------------------------------------------
    IF lt_fields IS INITIAL.
      LOOP AT lt_src_comp INTO ls_sc.
        " The client column is handled implicitly by Open SQL; naming it in
        " the projection is redundant and the parser rejects it.
        IF ls_sc-name = 'CLIENT' OR ls_sc-name = 'MANDT'.
          CONTINUE.
        ENDIF.
        APPEND |{ ls_sc-name }| TO es_plan-sel.
        APPEND VALUE #( name = ls_sc-name type = ls_sc-type ) TO es_plan-comp.
      ENDLOOP.
    ELSE.
      LOOP AT lt_fields INTO DATA(lv_f).
        lv_f = to_upper( lv_f ).
        READ TABLE lt_src_comp INTO ls_sc WITH KEY name = lv_f.
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          es_out = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>fail( iv_number = '023' iv_v1 = lv_f iv_v2 = es_plan-source ).
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.
        APPEND lv_f TO es_plan-sel.
        APPEND VALUE #( name = ls_sc-name type = ls_sc-type ) TO es_plan-comp.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.

    IF es_plan-sel IS INITIAL.
      es_out = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>fail( iv_number = '023' iv_v1 = '(none)' iv_v2 = es_plan-source ).
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " ---- filter ----------------------------------------------------------
    LOOP AT lt_filter INTO DATA(ls_flt).
      DATA(lv_field) = to_upper( ls_flt-field ).
      DATA(lv_op)    = to_upper( ls_flt-op ).

      READ TABLE lt_src_comp INTO ls_sc WITH KEY name = lv_field.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        es_out = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>fail( iv_number = '023' iv_v1 = lv_field iv_v2 = es_plan-source ).
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
      lo_ftype = ls_sc-type.

      " Delimited match, so a bare 'E' cannot slip through on 'NE'.
      IF lv_op IS INITIAL OR NOT c_ops CS |,{ lv_op },|.
        es_out = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>fail( iv_number = '024' iv_v1 = ls_flt-op ).
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.

      " IN carries a comma-separated list in Low, so each element is checked
      " inside the IN branch instead. Checking the joined string here would
      " reject any list longer than the column - which it always is.
      IF lv_op <> 'IN'.
        lv_why = literal_problem( iv_value = ls_flt-low io_type = lo_ftype ).
        IF lv_why IS INITIAL.
          lv_why = literal_problem( iv_value = ls_flt-high io_type = lo_ftype ).
        ENDIF.
        IF lv_why IS NOT INITIAL.
          es_out = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>fail( iv_number = '020'
                                             iv_v1     = es_plan-source
                                             iv_v2     = |filter on { lv_field }: { lv_why }| ).
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.

      CASE lv_op.
        WHEN 'BT'.
          lv_frag = |{ lv_field } BETWEEN { cl_abap_dyn_prg=>quote( ls_flt-low ) }|
                 && | AND { cl_abap_dyn_prg=>quote( ls_flt-high ) }|.
        WHEN 'IN'.
          CLEAR lv_in.
          SPLIT ls_flt-low AT ',' INTO TABLE DATA(lt_vals).
          LOOP AT lt_vals INTO DATA(lv_v).
            lv_why = literal_problem( iv_value = lv_v io_type = lo_ftype ).
            IF lv_why IS NOT INITIAL.
              es_out = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>fail( iv_number = '020'
                                                 iv_v1     = es_plan-source
                                                 iv_v2     = |filter on { lv_field }: { lv_why }| ).
              RETURN.
            ENDIF.
            lv_in = COND #( WHEN lv_in IS INITIAL
                            THEN cl_abap_dyn_prg=>quote( lv_v )
                            ELSE |{ lv_in }, { cl_abap_dyn_prg=>quote( lv_v ) }| ).
          ENDLOOP.
          lv_frag = |{ lv_field } IN ( { lv_in } )|.
        WHEN 'LIKE'.
          lv_frag = |{ lv_field } LIKE { cl_abap_dyn_prg=>quote( ls_flt-low ) }|.
        WHEN OTHERS.
          lv_frag = |{ lv_field } { lv_op } { cl_abap_dyn_prg=>quote( ls_flt-low ) }|.
      ENDCASE.

      IF es_plan-where IS NOT INITIAL.
        lv_frag = |AND { lv_frag }|.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND lv_frag TO es_plan-where.
    ENDLOOP.

    " ---- sort ------------------------------------------------------------
    LOOP AT lt_order INTO DATA(ls_ord).
      lv_field = to_upper( ls_ord-field ).
      IF NOT line_exists( lt_src_comp[ name = lv_field ] ).
        es_out = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>fail( iv_number = '023' iv_v1 = lv_field iv_v2 = es_plan-source ).
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND |{ lv_field } { COND string( WHEN ls_ord-descending = abap_true
                                          THEN 'DESCENDING' ELSE 'ASCENDING' ) }| TO es_plan-ord.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Always sort on something: an unordered capped read is not reproducible,
    " which is exactly what L-258 warns about. Read the first projected field
    " BEFORE the list is collapsed into its comma-separated form.
    IF es_plan-ord IS INITIAL.
      READ TABLE es_plan-sel INTO DATA(lv_first) INDEX 1.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        APPEND |{ lv_first } ASCENDING| TO es_plan-ord.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

    " Strict Open SQL needs the dynamic column and ORDER BY lists comma
    " separated in a single token row (L-309). The WHERE list is different -
    " its rows are blank-joined and each fragment carries its own AND.
    es_plan-sel = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>comma_join( es_plan-sel ).
    es_plan-ord = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>comma_join( es_plan-ord ).

    es_out-status = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>c_status-ok.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD execute.
    DATA lr_res TYPE REF TO data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_res> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.

    TRY.
        DATA(lo_line) = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( is_plan-comp ).
        DATA(lo_tab)  = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lo_line ).
        CREATE DATA lr_res TYPE HANDLE lo_tab.
      CATCH cx_sy_struct_creation cx_sy_table_creation cx_sy_create_data_error.
        rs_out = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>fail( iv_number = '021' iv_v1 = is_plan-source ).
        RETURN.
    ENDTRY.
    ASSIGN lr_res->* TO <lt_res>.

    TRY.
        SELECT (is_plan-sel)
          FROM (is_plan-source)
          WHERE (is_plan-where)
          ORDER BY (is_plan-ord)
          INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @<lt_res>
          UP TO @is_plan-max ROWS.
      CATCH cx_sy_dynamic_osql_error INTO DATA(lx_sql).
        rs_out = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>fail( iv_number = '020'
                                           iv_v1     = is_plan-source
                                           iv_v2     = lx_sql->get_text( ) ).
        RETURN.
      CATCH cx_sy_open_sql_error INTO DATA(lx_db).
        rs_out = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>fail( iv_number = '020'
                                           iv_v1     = is_plan-source
                                           iv_v2     = lx_db->get_text( ) ).
        RETURN.
    ENDTRY.

    rs_out           = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>succeed( iv_target = is_plan-source
                                                    iv_count  = lines( <lt_res> ) ).
    rs_out-rows_json = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>to_json( <lt_res> ).
  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.
submit:
**********************************************************************
* SUBMIT an allow-listed executable report.
*
* PREPARE refuses anything that could otherwise dump inside the RAP
* action, because a dump there reaches the consumer as an empty body
* with no reason at all (L-313).
*
* EXECUTE never submits directly: it calls ZFS_RFC_DYNGW_SUBMIT over
* DESTINATION 'NONE', so the report runs in its own internal session and
* its own LUW and a report that commits cannot corrupt the RAP
* transaction (L-227). That is also why the output capture lives in the
* FM rather than here - the SALV interceptor, the list memory and ABAP
* memory are all session-local.
**********************************************************************
CLASS zcl_fs_slc_gw_submit DEFINITION
  PUBLIC
  ABSTRACT
  FINAL.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS prepare
      IMPORTING is_step TYPE zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>ty_step
                is_reg  TYPE zfs_t_slc_dyngw
      EXPORTING es_plan TYPE zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>ty_sub_plan
                es_out  TYPE zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>ty_outcome.

    CLASS-METHODS execute
      IMPORTING is_plan       TYPE zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>ty_sub_plan
      RETURNING VALUE(rs_out) TYPE zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>ty_outcome.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    " RSPARAMS is the hard limit on what a selection entry can carry.
    CONSTANTS c_selname_len TYPE i      VALUE 8.
    CONSTANTS c_value_len   TYPE i      VALUE 45.
    CONSTANTS c_ops         TYPE string VALUE ',EQ,NE,GT,GE,LT,LE,BT,NB,CP,NP,'.

    "! The program's own selection screen, or an empty table when it
    "! cannot be read - in which case field names go unchecked rather
    "! than every field being refused.
    CLASS-METHODS screen_of
      IMPORTING iv_program       TYPE programm
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_screen) TYPE zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>tt_selparams.

ENDCLASS.


CLASS zcl_fs_slc_gw_submit IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD screen_of.
    CALL FUNCTION 'RS_REFRESH_FROM_SELECTOPTIONS'
      EXPORTING  curr_report     = iv_program
      TABLES     selection_table = rt_screen
      EXCEPTIONS not_found       = 1
                 no_report       = 2
                 OTHERS          = 3.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      CLEAR rt_screen.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD prepare.
    DATA lt_in     TYPE zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>tt_selparam.
    DATA lt_screen TYPE zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>tt_selparams.
    DATA ls_row    TYPE rsparams.
    DATA lv_subc   TYPE trdir-subc.
    DATA lv_name   TYPE rsscr_name.
    DATA lv_op     TYPE string.
    DATA: BEGIN OF ls_env,
            variant  TYPE variant,
            memoryid TYPE c LENGTH 30,
          END OF ls_env.

    CLEAR: es_plan, es_out.

    es_plan-program = to_upper( |{ is_step-targetname }| ).
    es_plan-mode    = to_upper( |{ is_step-operation }| ).
    IF es_plan-mode IS INITIAL.
      es_plan-mode = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>c_capture-salv.
    ENDIF.

    IF es_plan-mode <> zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>c_capture-salv
       AND es_plan-mode <> zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>c_capture-list
       AND es_plan-mode <> zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>c_capture-memo
       AND es_plan-mode <> zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>c_capture-none.
      es_out = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>fail( iv_number = '028' iv_v1 = |{ es_plan-mode }| ).
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Customer namespace only. A registry mistake must not be able to
    " reach an SAP-standard utility report.
    IF es_plan-program(1) <> 'Z' AND es_plan-program(1) <> 'Y'.
      es_out = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>fail( iv_number = '027' iv_v1 = |{ es_plan-program }| ).
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Must exist and be an executable report: SUBC '1'. This rejects
    " includes, module pools, subroutine pools and function-group main
    " programs, every one of which would dump on SUBMIT.
    SELECT SINGLE subc FROM trdir WHERE name = @es_plan-program INTO @lv_subc.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR lv_subc <> '1'.
      es_out = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>fail( iv_number = '027' iv_v1 = |{ es_plan-program }| ).
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Run envelope: optional variant and ABAP-memory id.
    IF is_step-importjson IS NOT INITIAL.
      TRY.
          /ui2/cl_json=>deserialize( EXPORTING json = is_step-importjson
                                     CHANGING  data = ls_env ).
        CATCH cx_root.
          es_out = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>fail( iv_number = '022' iv_v1 = 'ImportJson' ).
          RETURN.
      ENDTRY.
    ENDIF.
    es_plan-variant   = to_upper( |{ ls_env-variant }| ).
    es_plan-memory_id = to_upper( |{ ls_env-memoryid }| ).

    IF es_plan-variant IS NOT INITIAL.
      SELECT SINGLE variant FROM varid
        WHERE report  = @es_plan-program
          AND variant = @es_plan-variant
        INTO @DATA(lv_found).
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        es_out = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>fail( iv_number = '030'
                                           iv_v1     = |{ es_plan-variant }|
                                           iv_v2     = |{ es_plan-program }| ).
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

    IF es_plan-mode = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>c_capture-memo AND es_plan-memory_id IS INITIAL.
      es_out = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>fail( iv_number = '022' iv_v1 = 'ImportJson.MemoryId' ).
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Selection table. Carried in the same field as a QURY filter and for
    " the same reason: a caller-supplied value must never reach the
    " callee unchecked.
    IF is_step-filterjson IS NOT INITIAL.
      TRY.
          /ui2/cl_json=>deserialize( EXPORTING json = is_step-filterjson
                                     CHANGING  data = lt_in ).
        CATCH cx_root.
          es_out = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>fail( iv_number = '022' iv_v1 = 'FilterJson' ).
          RETURN.
      ENDTRY.
    ENDIF.

    IF lt_in IS NOT INITIAL.
      lt_screen = screen_of( es_plan-program ).
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT lt_in INTO DATA(ls_in).

      IF strlen( ls_in-field ) > c_selname_len.
        es_out = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>fail( iv_number = '023'
                                           iv_v1     = |{ ls_in-field }|
                                           iv_v2     = |{ es_plan-program }| ).
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
      lv_name = to_upper( ls_in-field ).

      CLEAR ls_row.
      ls_row-selname = lv_name.
      ls_row-kind    = 'S'.

      " When the screen could be read the field must really be on it, and
      " its parameter/select-option kind comes from there rather than
      " from the caller's say-so.
      IF lt_screen IS NOT INITIAL.
        READ TABLE lt_screen INTO DATA(ls_scr) WITH KEY selname = lv_name.
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          es_out = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>fail( iv_number = '023'
                                             iv_v1     = |{ lv_name }|
                                             iv_v2     = |{ es_plan-program }| ).
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.
        ls_row-kind = ls_scr-kind.
      ELSEIF ls_in-kind IS NOT INITIAL.
        ls_row-kind = to_upper( ls_in-kind ).
      ENDIF.

      ls_row-sign = COND #( WHEN ls_in-sign IS INITIAL THEN 'I'
                            ELSE to_upper( ls_in-sign ) ).
      IF ls_row-sign <> 'I' AND ls_row-sign <> 'E'.
        es_out = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>fail( iv_number = '029'
                                           iv_v1     = |{ ls_in-sign }|
                                           iv_v2     = |{ lv_name }| ).
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.

      lv_op = COND #( WHEN ls_in-op IS INITIAL THEN 'EQ'
                      ELSE to_upper( ls_in-op ) ).
      IF strlen( lv_op ) > 2 OR c_ops NS |,{ lv_op },|.
        es_out = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>fail( iv_number = '024' iv_v1 = lv_op ).
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
      ls_row-option = lv_op.

      " RSPARAMS-LOW/HIGH are CHAR 45. A longer literal would be
      " truncated silently - the SUBM analogue of L-310.
      IF strlen( ls_in-low ) > c_value_len.
        es_out = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>fail( iv_number = '029'
                                           iv_v1     = |{ ls_in-low }|
                                           iv_v2     = |{ lv_name }| ).
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
      IF strlen( ls_in-high ) > c_value_len.
        es_out = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>fail( iv_number = '029'
                                           iv_v1     = |{ ls_in-high }|
                                           iv_v2     = |{ lv_name }| ).
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
      IF ( lv_op = 'BT' OR lv_op = 'NB' ) AND ls_in-high IS INITIAL.
        es_out = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>fail( iv_number = '029'
                                           iv_v1     = |{ lv_op }|
                                           iv_v2     = |{ lv_name }| ).
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
      ls_row-low  = ls_in-low.
      ls_row-high = ls_in-high.

      APPEND ls_row TO es_plan-sel.
    ENDLOOP.

    es_plan-max = is_step-maxrows.
    IF es_plan-max <= 0.
      es_plan-max = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>c_max_rows_default.
    ENDIF.
    IF is_reg-max_rows > 0 AND es_plan-max > is_reg-max_rows.
      es_out = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>fail( iv_number = '025'
                                         iv_v1     = |{ es_plan-max }|
                                         iv_v2     = |{ is_reg-max_rows }| ).
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    es_out-status = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>c_status-ok.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD execute.
    DATA lt_sel    TYPE zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>tt_selparams.
    DATA lv_status TYPE zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>ty_status.
    DATA lv_msgno  TYPE symsgno.
    DATA lv_msg    TYPE string.
    DATA lv_rows   TYPE string.
    DATA lv_exp    TYPE string.
    DATA lv_count  TYPE i.
    DATA lv_rfcmsg TYPE c LENGTH 200.

    lt_sel = is_plan-sel.

    CALL FUNCTION 'ZFS_RFC_DYNGW_SUBMIT' DESTINATION zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>c_rfc_dest
      EXPORTING  iv_program            = is_plan-program
                 iv_mode               = is_plan-mode
                 iv_variant            = is_plan-variant
                 iv_memory_id          = is_plan-memory_id
                 iv_max_rows           = is_plan-max
      IMPORTING  ev_status             = lv_status
                 ev_msgno              = lv_msgno
                 ev_message            = lv_msg
                 ev_rows_json          = lv_rows
                 ev_export_json        = lv_exp
                 ev_count              = lv_count
      TABLES     it_selparams          = lt_sel
      EXCEPTIONS system_failure        = 1 MESSAGE lv_rfcmsg
                 communication_failure = 2 MESSAGE lv_rfcmsg
                 OTHERS                = 3.

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      rs_out = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>fail( iv_number = '020'
                                         iv_v1     = |{ is_plan-program }|
                                         iv_v2     = |RFC { sy-subrc }: { lv_rfcmsg }| ).
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rs_out-status      = lv_status.
    rs_out-msgno       = lv_msgno.
    rs_out-msgtext     = lv_msg.
    rs_out-rows_json   = lv_rows.
    rs_out-export_json = lv_exp.
    rs_out-row_count   = lv_count.
  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.
dispatch:
**********************************************************************
* The single dispatch entry point. Everything routes through here, so
* the four actions differ only in how they build their step list.
*
* PLAN validates one step and yields a plan without touching data; RUN
* executes a prepared plan. That split is what lets ExecuteBatch validate
* a whole batch before the first write happens.
*
* RUN_SINGLE and RUN_BATCH are the two entry points the behaviour pool
* calls. Nothing in this class knows about RAP: a batch that must be
* rolled back says so through EV_ABORT and the pool does the failing,
* because only a behaviour handler can reach failed- / reported-.
*
* CALL LOGGING is delegated to ZCL_FS_SLC_GW_LOG: payload caps, the
* per-step child rows, the LOG_LEVEL decision, and the durable
* out-of-band write on the abort path. See that class for why the abort
* path cannot use the staged GT_LOG row.
**********************************************************************
CLASS zcl_fs_slc_gw_dispatch DEFINITION
  PUBLIC
  ABSTRACT
  FINAL.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    "! Validates one step and yields a plan. Touches no data.
    CLASS-METHODS plan
      IMPORTING is_step TYPE zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>ty_step
      EXPORTING es_plan TYPE zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>ty_plan
                es_out  TYPE zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>ty_outcome.

    "! Runs a prepared plan.
    CLASS-METHODS run
      IMPORTING is_plan       TYPE zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>ty_plan
      RETURNING VALUE(rs_out) TYPE zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>ty_outcome.

    "! One single-shot action: plan, run, log, answer.
    CLASS-METHODS run_single
      IMPORTING is_req         TYPE zfs_ae_dyngwrequest
                iv_kind        TYPE zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>ty_kind
      RETURNING VALUE(rs_resp) TYPE zfs_ae_dyngwresponse.

    "! One ExecuteBatch call. EV_ABORT says "fail the RAP request so the LUW
    "! rolls back" - the caller owns that, because only the behaviour handler
    "! can reach failed-/reported-. Nothing in this class knows about RAP.
    CLASS-METHODS run_batch
      IMPORTING is_req   TYPE zfs_ae_dyngwrequest
      EXPORTING es_resp  TYPE zfs_ae_dyngwresponse
                ev_abort TYPE abap_bool.

  PRIVATE SECTION.

    "! Stages one call-log row and builds the response payload.
    CLASS-METHODS finish
      IMPORTING is_req         TYPE zfs_ae_dyngwrequest
                is_reg         TYPE zfs_t_slc_dyngw
                is_out         TYPE zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>ty_outcome
                iv_kind        TYPE zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>ty_kind
                iv_started     TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(rs_resp) TYPE zfs_ae_dyngwresponse.

ENDCLASS.


CLASS zcl_fs_slc_gw_dispatch IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD plan.
    DATA ls_reg TYPE zfs_t_slc_dyngw.
    DATA ls_out TYPE zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>ty_outcome.

    CLEAR: es_plan, es_out.
    es_plan-step      = is_step.
    es_plan-step-kind = to_upper( |{ is_step-kind }| ).

    IF es_plan-step-targetname IS INITIAL.
      es_out = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>fail( iv_number = '017' iv_v1 = '(blank)' ).
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    CASE es_plan-step-kind.

      WHEN zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>c_kind-func.
        " The SUBM wrapper must never be reachable as a plain FUNC target:
        " called that way it would skip the namespace guard, the SUBC
        " check, the selection-screen validation and the row cap.
        IF to_upper( |{ es_plan-step-targetname }| ) = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>c_submit_fm.
          es_out = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>fail( iv_number = '018'
                                             iv_v1     = |{ es_plan-step-kind }|
                                             iv_v2     = |{ es_plan-step-targetname }| ).
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.
        " An FM can do anything, so a registered FM target needs allow_write.
        zcl_fs_slc_gw_registry=>resolve(
          EXPORTING iv_kind  = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>c_kind-func
                    iv_name  = es_plan-step-targetname
                    iv_write = abap_true
          IMPORTING es_row   = ls_reg
                    es_out   = ls_out ).
        IF ls_out-status <> zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>c_status-ok.
          es_out = ls_out.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.
        es_plan-reg = ls_reg.
        zcl_fs_slc_gw_func=>prepare( EXPORTING is_reg  = ls_reg
                                               is_step = es_plan-step
                                     IMPORTING es_plan = es_plan-fm
                                               es_out  = es_out ).

      WHEN zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>c_kind-tabl.
        zcl_fs_slc_gw_registry=>resolve(
          EXPORTING iv_kind      = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>c_kind-tabl
                    iv_name      = es_plan-step-targetname
                    iv_operation = es_plan-step-operation
                    iv_write     = abap_true
          IMPORTING es_row       = ls_reg
                    es_out       = ls_out ).
        IF ls_out-status <> zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>c_status-ok.
          es_out = ls_out.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.
        es_plan-reg = ls_reg.
        zcl_fs_slc_gw_table=>prepare( EXPORTING is_step = es_plan-step
                                      IMPORTING es_plan = es_plan-tab
                                                es_out  = es_out ).

      WHEN zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>c_kind-qury.
        zcl_fs_slc_gw_registry=>resolve(
          EXPORTING iv_kind  = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>c_kind-qury
                    iv_name  = es_plan-step-targetname
                    iv_write = abap_false
          IMPORTING es_row   = ls_reg
                    es_out   = ls_out ).
        IF ls_out-status <> zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>c_status-ok.
          es_out = ls_out.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.
        es_plan-reg = ls_reg.
        zcl_fs_slc_gw_query=>prepare( EXPORTING is_step = es_plan-step
                                                is_reg  = ls_reg
                                      IMPORTING es_plan = es_plan-qry
                                                es_out  = es_out ).

      WHEN zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>c_kind-subm.
        " An executable report can do anything its caller can, so a SUBM
        " target needs allow_write even when the report only reads.
        zcl_fs_slc_gw_registry=>resolve(
          EXPORTING iv_kind      = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>c_kind-subm
                    iv_name      = es_plan-step-targetname
                    iv_operation = es_plan-step-operation
                    iv_write     = abap_true
          IMPORTING es_row       = ls_reg
                    es_out       = ls_out ).
        IF ls_out-status <> zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>c_status-ok.
          es_out = ls_out.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.
        es_plan-reg = ls_reg.
        zcl_fs_slc_gw_submit=>prepare( EXPORTING is_step = es_plan-step
                                                 is_reg  = ls_reg
                                       IMPORTING es_plan = es_plan-sub
                                                 es_out  = es_out ).

      WHEN OTHERS.
        es_out = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>fail( iv_number = '018'
                                           iv_v1     = |{ es_plan-step-kind }|
                                           iv_v2     = |{ es_plan-step-targetname }| ).
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD run.
    CASE is_plan-step-kind.
      WHEN zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>c_kind-func.
        rs_out = zcl_fs_slc_gw_func=>execute( is_plan-fm ).
      WHEN zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>c_kind-tabl.
        rs_out = zcl_fs_slc_gw_table=>execute( is_plan-tab ).
      WHEN zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>c_kind-qury.
        rs_out = zcl_fs_slc_gw_query=>execute( is_plan-qry ).
      WHEN zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>c_kind-subm.
        rs_out = zcl_fs_slc_gw_submit=>execute( is_plan-sub ).
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rs_out = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>fail( iv_number = '018'
                                           iv_v1     = |{ is_plan-step-kind }|
                                           iv_v2     = |{ is_plan-step-targetname }| ).
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD finish.
    DATA ls_log TYPE zfs_t_slc_dyngw.
    DATA lv_now TYPE timestampl.
    DATA lv_t1  TYPE i.

    GET RUN TIME FIELD lv_t1.
    GET TIME STAMP FIELD lv_now.

    ls_log-client        = sy-mandt.
    ls_log-uuid          = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>new_uuid( ).
    ls_log-entry_type    = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>c_entry-log.
    ls_log-target_kind   = iv_kind.
    ls_log-target_name   = is_req-targetname.
    ls_log-operation     = is_req-operation.
    ls_log-registry_uuid = is_reg-uuid.
    ls_log-exec_status   = is_out-status.
    ls_log-message_id    = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>c_msgid.
    ls_log-message_no    = is_out-msgno.
    ls_log-message_text  = is_out-msgtext.
    ls_log-row_count     = is_out-row_count.
    ls_log-duration_ms   = ( lv_t1 - iv_started ) / 1000.
    ls_log-executed_by   = sy-uname.
    ls_log-executed_at   = lv_now.
    ls_log-request_json  = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>to_json( is_req ).
    ls_log-response_json = |{ is_out-export_json }{ is_out-tables_json }{ is_out-rows_json }|.

    " Caps and the successful-QURY rule. The response built below comes
    " from IS_OUT and is deliberately untouched - only what gets stored is
    " capped, so the contract is unchanged.
    zcl_fs_slc_gw_log=>apply_caps( CHANGING cs_row = ls_log ).

    zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>audit_fields( CHANGING cs_row = ls_log ).

    " Whether a row is written at all belongs to the registry row, not to
    " this class. A blank LOG_LEVEL means ALL, so every target that exists
    " today keeps behaving exactly as it does now with nothing migrated.
    "
    " GWUUID is still returned either way: it identifies the call, and a
    " caller that switched logging off for a target should not also lose
    " its correlation id.
    IF zcl_fs_slc_gw_log=>level_allows( iv_level  = is_reg-log_level
                                        iv_status = is_out-status ) = abap_true.
      APPEND ls_log TO zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>gt_log.
    ENDIF.

    rs_resp-gwuuid      = ls_log-uuid.
    rs_resp-execstatus  = is_out-status.
    rs_resp-messagetext = is_out-msgtext.
    rs_resp-exportjson  = is_out-export_json.
    rs_resp-tablesjson  = is_out-tables_json.
    rs_resp-rowsjson    = is_out-rows_json.
    rs_resp-resultcount = is_out-row_count.
    rs_resp-durationms  = ls_log-duration_ms.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD run_single.
    DATA ls_plan TYPE zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>ty_plan.
    DATA ls_out  TYPE zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>ty_outcome.
    DATA lv_t0   TYPE i.

    GET RUN TIME FIELD lv_t0.
    zcl_fs_slc_gw_registry=>reset( ).

    DATA(ls_step) = VALUE zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>ty_step(
      kind        = iv_kind
      targetname  = is_req-targetname
      operation   = COND #( WHEN is_req-operation IS NOT INITIAL
                            THEN is_req-operation
                            WHEN iv_kind = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>c_kind-qury
                            THEN zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>c_op-select
                            WHEN iv_kind = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>c_kind-func
                            THEN zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>c_op-call
                            ELSE is_req-operation )
      importjson  = is_req-importjson
      tablesjson  = is_req-tablesjson
      fieldsjson  = is_req-fieldsjson
      filterjson  = is_req-filterjson
      orderbyjson = is_req-orderbyjson
      maxrows     = is_req-maxrows ).

    plan( EXPORTING is_step = ls_step
          IMPORTING es_plan = ls_plan
                    es_out  = ls_out ).
    IF ls_out-status = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>c_status-ok.
      ls_out = run( ls_plan ).
    ENDIF.

    rs_resp = finish( is_req     = is_req
                      is_reg     = ls_plan-reg
                      is_out     = ls_out
                      iv_kind    = iv_kind
                      iv_started = lv_t0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD run_batch.
    DATA lt_steps   TYPE zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>tt_step.
    DATA lt_plan    TYPE zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>tt_plan.
    DATA lt_res     TYPE zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>tt_step_result.
    DATA ls_plan    TYPE zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>ty_plan.
    DATA ls_out     TYPE zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>ty_outcome.
    DATA ls_overall TYPE zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>ty_outcome.
    DATA lv_t0      TYPE i.
    DATA lv_ts      TYPE i.
    DATA lv_te      TYPE i.
    DATA lv_idx     TYPE i.
    DATA lv_rfc     TYPE abap_bool.
    " Set once a step has executed whose effects this request can still roll
    " back - a TABL write in the RAP LUW, or a FUNC call on the shared RFC
    " session. Until then there is nothing for an abort to undo.
    DATA lv_dirty   TYPE abap_bool.
    " Phase 1 rejected the batch, so nothing executed at all and every step
    " row belongs to the prepare phase - not only the step that was refused.
    DATA lv_phase1_failed TYPE abap_bool.

    CLEAR: es_resp, ev_abort.
    GET RUN TIME FIELD lv_t0.
    zcl_fs_slc_gw_registry=>reset( ).

    TRY.
        /ui2/cl_json=>deserialize( EXPORTING json = is_req-stepsjson
                                   CHANGING  data = lt_steps ).
      CATCH cx_root.
        ls_overall = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>fail( iv_number = '022' iv_v1 = 'StepsJson' ).
    ENDTRY.

    IF ls_overall-status <> zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>c_status-error AND lt_steps IS INITIAL.
      ls_overall = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>fail( iv_number = '022' iv_v1 = 'StepsJson' ).
    ENDIF.

    " ---- phase 1: plan every step before anything executes ---------------
    IF ls_overall-status <> zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>c_status-error.
      CLEAR lv_idx.
      LOOP AT lt_steps INTO DATA(ls_step).
        lv_idx = lv_idx + 1.
        plan( EXPORTING is_step = ls_step
              IMPORTING es_plan = ls_plan
                        es_out  = ls_out ).
        " 'P' until phase 2 actually runs it, so a batch rejected in
        " validation never reports a step as having succeeded.
        APPEND VALUE #( step        = lv_idx
                        kind        = ls_plan-step-kind
                        targetname  = ls_step-targetname
                        operation   = ls_step-operation
                        execstatus  = COND #( WHEN ls_out-status = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>c_status-ok
                                              THEN zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>c_status-planned
                                              ELSE ls_out-status )
                        messageno   = ls_out-msgno
                        messagetext = ls_out-msgtext ) TO lt_res.
        IF ls_out-status <> zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>c_status-ok.
          lv_phase1_failed = abap_true.
          ls_overall = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>fail(
            iv_number = '020'
            iv_v1     = |batch step { lv_idx }|
            iv_v2     = |{ ls_out-msgtext }| ).
          EXIT.
        ENDIF.
        APPEND ls_plan TO lt_plan.
        IF ls_plan-step-kind = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>c_kind-func
           AND ls_plan-fm-mode = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>c_mode-rfc.
          lv_rfc = abap_true.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.

    " ---- phase 2: execute, in order --------------------------------------
    IF ls_overall-status <> zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>c_status-error.
      CLEAR lv_idx.
      LOOP AT lt_plan INTO ls_plan.
        lv_idx = lv_idx + 1.
        GET RUN TIME FIELD lv_ts.
        ls_out = run( ls_plan ).
        GET RUN TIME FIELD lv_te.

        READ TABLE lt_res ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<ls_r>) INDEX lv_idx.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          <ls_r>-execstatus  = ls_out-status.
          <ls_r>-messageno   = ls_out-msgno.
          <ls_r>-messagetext = ls_out-msgtext.
          <ls_r>-exportjson  = ls_out-export_json.
          <ls_r>-tablesjson  = ls_out-tables_json.
          <ls_r>-rowsjson    = ls_out-rows_json.
          <ls_r>-resultcount = ls_out-row_count.
          <ls_r>-durationms  = ( lv_te - lv_ts ) / 1000.
        ENDIF.

        IF ls_out-status <> zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>c_status-ok.
          ls_overall = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>fail(
            iv_number = '020'
            iv_v1     = |batch step { lv_idx }|
            iv_v2     = |{ ls_out-msgtext }| ).

          " A SUBM step ran behind DESTINATION 'NONE', in its own internal
          " session and its own LUW, and has already committed or not on its
          " own. There is nothing here for a rollback to undo, so failing the
          " RAP request would buy no atomicity at all - and it would cost the
          " caller the entire diagnosis, because a failed RAP request answers
          " with a zero-length body (L-313, measured in L-328: messages 020,
          " 031 and 032 were unreachable). So report it, stop, and return 200
          " with the per-step detail intact.
          "
          " Only while nothing rollback-worthy has run, though: once a TABL
          " write or an RFC FUNC step has executed, the abort is the only
          " mechanism available (L-227 forbids an explicit ROLLBACK WORK in a
          " behaviour class) and it takes precedence over diagnosability.
          IF ls_plan-step-kind = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>c_kind-subm AND lv_dirty = abap_false.
            EXIT.
          ENDIF.

          ev_abort = abap_true.
          EXIT.
        ENDIF.

        " QURY reads nothing back and SUBM owns its own LUW, so neither makes
        " this request dirty.
        IF ls_plan-step-kind = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>c_kind-tabl
           OR ls_plan-step-kind = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>c_kind-func.
          lv_dirty = abap_true.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.

    " ---- RFC session: commit or roll back --------------------------------
    IF lv_rfc = abap_true.
      DATA(lv_cm) = COND #( WHEN is_req-commitmode IS INITIAL
                            THEN zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>c_commit-auto
                            ELSE to_upper( |{ is_req-commitmode }| ) ).
      IF ev_abort = abap_true OR ls_overall-status = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>c_status-error.
        zcl_fs_slc_gw_func=>rollback( ).
      ELSEIF lv_cm = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>c_commit-always
             OR lv_cm = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>c_commit-auto.
        IF zcl_fs_slc_gw_func=>commit( ) = abap_false.
          ls_overall = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>fail( iv_number = '020'
                                                 iv_v1     = 'BAPI_TRANSACTION_COMMIT'
                                                 iv_v2     = 'commit was refused' ).
          ev_abort = abap_true.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

    IF ls_overall-status <> zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>c_status-error.
      ls_overall = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>succeed( iv_target = 'ExecuteBatch'
                                                iv_count  = lines( lt_res ) ).
    ENDIF.
    ls_overall-rows_json = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>to_json( lt_res ).
    ls_overall-row_count = lines( lt_res ).

    es_resp = finish( is_req     = is_req
                      is_reg     = VALUE zfs_t_slc_dyngw( )
                      is_out     = ls_overall
                      iv_kind    = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>c_kind-batch
                      iv_started = lv_t0 ).

    " One child row per step, parented to the call row FINISH just staged.
    " Turns "which step failed, and had anything run?" from prose inside
    " RESPONSE_JSON into two columns.
    "
    " These follow the batch call row's logging decision, not each target's
    " own LOG_LEVEL: the per-step registry row is not carried in
    " TY_STEP_RESULT, and adding it there would change the serialised
    " response and therefore the contract.
    APPEND LINES OF zcl_fs_slc_gw_log=>step_rows(
                      iv_parent        = es_resp-gwuuid
                      it_res           = lt_res
                      iv_phase1_failed = lv_phase1_failed )
           TO zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>gt_log.

    IF ev_abort = abap_true.
      " The staged rows cannot survive here: the caller is about to fail the
      " RAP request, the LUW rolls back, and the saver has not written them
      " yet. Clearing them was the old behaviour and it kept the log honest
      " at the cost of leaving an aborted batch with no trace at all - which
      " is the mechanical cause of L-313's empty HTTP 400.
      "
      " So emit them out of band first. ZFS_RFC_DYNGW_LOG runs over
      " DESTINATION 'NONE' in its own LUW and commits independently. Honest
      " and durable, rather than one at the expense of the other. It cannot
      " raise and cannot fail this request.
      zcl_fs_slc_gw_log=>emit_durable( zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>gt_log ).
      CLEAR zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>gt_log.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.
registry:
**********************************************************************
* The allow-list. Every dispatch starts here.
**********************************************************************
CLASS zcl_fs_slc_gw_registry DEFINITION
  PUBLIC
  ABSTRACT
  FINAL.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    "! Resolves one target and checks its permissions.
    CLASS-METHODS resolve
      IMPORTING iv_kind      TYPE zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>ty_kind
                iv_name      TYPE zfs_t_slc_dyngw-target_name
                iv_operation TYPE zfs_t_slc_dyngw-operation OPTIONAL
                iv_write     TYPE abap_bool DEFAULT abap_false
      EXPORTING es_row       TYPE zfs_t_slc_dyngw
                es_out       TYPE zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>ty_outcome.

    "! Drops the per-request buffer. Called once per action.
    CLASS-METHODS reset.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_buf,
             kind TYPE zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>ty_kind,
             name TYPE zfs_t_slc_dyngw-target_name,
             hit  TYPE abap_bool,
             row  TYPE zfs_t_slc_dyngw,
           END OF ty_buf.
    " A batch commonly names the same target repeatedly; buffering keeps
    " that to one SELECT per distinct target per request.
    CLASS-DATA gt_buf TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_buf WITH UNIQUE KEY kind name.

ENDCLASS.


CLASS zcl_fs_slc_gw_registry IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD reset.
    CLEAR gt_buf.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD resolve.
    DATA ls_buf TYPE ty_buf.

    CLEAR: es_row, es_out.

    READ TABLE gt_buf INTO ls_buf WITH TABLE KEY kind = iv_kind name = iv_name.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      ls_buf-kind = iv_kind.
      ls_buf-name = iv_name.
      SELECT SINGLE * FROM zfs_t_slc_dyngw
        WHERE entry_type  = @zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>c_entry-registry
          AND target_kind = @iv_kind
          AND target_name = @iv_name
          AND is_active   = @abap_true
        INTO @ls_buf-row.
      ls_buf-hit = xsdbool( sy-subrc = 0 ).
      INSERT ls_buf INTO TABLE gt_buf.
    ENDIF.

    IF ls_buf-hit = abap_false.
      es_out = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>fail( iv_number = '017' iv_v1 = |{ iv_name }| ).
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.
    es_row = ls_buf-row.

    " A registry row may pin itself to a single operation; blank means "any".
    IF es_row-operation IS NOT INITIAL
       AND iv_operation IS NOT INITIAL
       AND es_row-operation <> iv_operation.
      es_out = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>fail( iv_number = '018'
                                         iv_v1     = |{ iv_operation }|
                                         iv_v2     = |{ iv_name }| ).
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    IF iv_write = abap_true AND es_row-allow_write <> abap_true.
      es_out = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>fail( iv_number = '018'
                                         iv_v1     = |{ iv_operation }|
                                         iv_v2     = |{ iv_name }| ).
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    IF iv_write = abap_false AND es_row-allow_read <> abap_true.
      es_out = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>fail( iv_number = '018'
                                         iv_v1     = |{ iv_operation }|
                                         iv_v2     = |{ iv_name }| ).
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    es_out-status = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>c_status-ok.
  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.
base:
**********************************************************************
* Dynamic OData gateway - shared foundation.
*
* Types, constants and the small utilities every other gateway class
* depends on. Holds no dispatch logic of its own.
*
*   ty_step / ty_plan / ty_outcome   the shapes passed between the
*                                    dispatcher and the workers
*   c_kind / c_status / c_op / ...   the magic values, named once
*   fail( ) / succeed( ) / msg( )    ZFS_TRM_MSG formatting, in one place
*   descr_for( )                     a type descriptor, but only when the
*                                    type can actually be instantiated -
*                                    a generic type describes fine and
*                                    then fails on CREATE DATA (L-311)
*   json_keys( )                     which parameters the caller really
*                                    sent, so an unsent optional is never
*                                    bound as its initial value
*   comma_join( )                    a dynamic column list must be ONE
*                                    comma-separated row in strict Open
*                                    SQL (L-309)
*   gt_log                           call-log rows staged by the actions
*                                    and drained by the RAP saver, so the
*                                    log lands in RAP's own COMMIT
*
* The architecture overview for the whole gateway lives in the behaviour
* pool ZBP_FS_DYNGATEWAYTP; the safety model it describes is enforced
* across ZCL_FS_SLC_GW_REGISTRY and the four worker classes.
**********************************************************************
CLASS zcl_fs_slc_gw_base DEFINITION
  PUBLIC
  ABSTRACT
  FINAL.

  PUBLIC SECTION.

    TYPES ty_msgtext TYPE c LENGTH 220.
    " Named types: a RETURNING parameter cannot be typed inline with
    " TYPE c LENGTH n, it needs a complete named type.
    TYPES ty_mode    TYPE c LENGTH 1.
    TYPES ty_kind    TYPE c LENGTH 4.
    TYPES ty_status  TYPE c LENGTH 1.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_outcome,
             status      TYPE ty_status,
             msgno       TYPE symsgno,
             msgtext     TYPE ty_msgtext,
             export_json TYPE string,
             tables_json TYPE string,
             rows_json   TYPE string,
             row_count   TYPE i,
           END OF ty_outcome.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_filter,
             field TYPE string,
             op    TYPE string,
             low   TYPE string,
             high  TYPE string,
           END OF ty_filter.
    TYPES tt_filter TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_filter WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_order,
             field      TYPE string,
             descending TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_order.
    TYPES tt_order TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_order WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES tt_name TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES tt_log  TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF zfs_t_slc_dyngw WITH EMPTY KEY.

    " One unit of work. The single-shot actions build one of these from the
    " request; ExecuteBatch deserialises an array of them from StepsJson.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_step,
             kind        TYPE ty_kind,
             targetname  TYPE c LENGTH 30,
             operation   TYPE c LENGTH 10,
             importjson  TYPE string,
             tablesjson  TYPE string,
             fieldsjson  TYPE string,
             filterjson  TYPE string,
             orderbyjson TYPE string,
             maxrows     TYPE i,
           END OF ty_step.
    TYPES tt_step TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_step WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_step_result,
             step        TYPE i,
             kind        TYPE ty_kind,
             targetname  TYPE c LENGTH 30,
             operation   TYPE c LENGTH 10,
             execstatus  TYPE ty_status,
             messageno   TYPE symsgno,
             messagetext TYPE ty_msgtext,
             exportjson  TYPE string,
             tablesjson  TYPE string,
             rowsjson    TYPE string,
             resultcount TYPE i,
             durationms  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_step_result.
    TYPES tt_step_result TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_step_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    " ---- plans produced by PREPARE, consumed by EXECUTE -----------------
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_fm_plan,
             fm    TYPE c LENGTH 30,
             mode  TYPE ty_mode,
             ptab  TYPE abap_func_parmbind_tab,
             etab  TYPE abap_func_excpbind_tab,
             r_exp TYPE REF TO data,
             r_chg TYPE REF TO data,
             r_tab TYPE REF TO data,
           END OF ty_fm_plan.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_tab_plan,
             name      TYPE string,
             operation TYPE c LENGTH 10,
             r_rows    TYPE REF TO data,
           END OF ty_tab_plan.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_qry_plan,
             source TYPE string,
             sel    TYPE tt_name,
             where  TYPE tt_name,
             ord    TYPE tt_name,
             comp   TYPE abap_component_tab,
             max    TYPE i,
           END OF ty_qry_plan.

    TYPES tt_selparams TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF rsparams WITH EMPTY KEY.

    " One caller-supplied selection-screen entry. Deliberately the same
    " shape as ty_filter plus KIND and SIGN, so FilterJson carries a
    " selection table for a SUBM step exactly as it carries a WHERE for a
    " QURY step, and the same length guards apply (L-310).
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_selparam,
             field TYPE string,
             kind  TYPE string,
             sign  TYPE string,
             op    TYPE string,
             low   TYPE string,
             high  TYPE string,
           END OF ty_selparam.
    TYPES tt_selparam TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_selparam WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sub_plan,
             program   TYPE programm,
             mode      TYPE c LENGTH 10,
             variant   TYPE variant,
             memory_id TYPE c LENGTH 30,
             max       TYPE i,
             sel       TYPE tt_selparams,
           END OF ty_sub_plan.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_plan,
             step TYPE ty_step,
             reg  TYPE zfs_t_slc_dyngw,
             fm   TYPE ty_fm_plan,
             tab  TYPE ty_tab_plan,
             qry  TYPE ty_qry_plan,
             sub  TYPE ty_sub_plan,
           END OF ty_plan.
    TYPES tt_plan TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_plan WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CONSTANTS c_msgid TYPE symsgid VALUE 'ZFS_TRM_MSG'.

    CONSTANTS: BEGIN OF c_kind,
                 func  TYPE ty_kind VALUE 'FUNC',
                 tabl  TYPE ty_kind VALUE 'TABL',
                 qury  TYPE ty_kind VALUE 'QURY',
                 subm  TYPE ty_kind VALUE 'SUBM',
                 batch TYPE ty_kind VALUE 'BTCH',
               END OF c_kind.

    CONSTANTS: BEGIN OF c_entry,
                 registry TYPE c LENGTH 1 VALUE 'R',
                 log      TYPE c LENGTH 1 VALUE 'L',
               END OF c_entry.

    CONSTANTS: BEGIN OF c_status,
                 ok      TYPE ty_status VALUE 'S',
                 error   TYPE ty_status VALUE 'E',
                 " Planned successfully but never executed, because a later
                 " step failed validation and the batch never started.
                 planned TYPE ty_status VALUE 'P',
               END OF c_status.

    CONSTANTS: BEGIN OF c_op,
                 insert TYPE c LENGTH 10 VALUE 'INSERT',
                 modify TYPE c LENGTH 10 VALUE 'MODIFY',
                 delete TYPE c LENGTH 10 VALUE 'DELETE',
                 select TYPE c LENGTH 10 VALUE 'SELECT',
                 call   TYPE c LENGTH 10 VALUE 'CALL',
               END OF c_op.

    CONSTANTS: BEGIN OF c_commit,
                 auto   TYPE c LENGTH 6 VALUE 'AUTO',
                 always TYPE c LENGTH 6 VALUE 'ALWAYS',
                 never  TYPE c LENGTH 6 VALUE 'NEVER',
               END OF c_commit.

    CONSTANTS: BEGIN OF c_mode,
                 rfc   TYPE ty_mode VALUE 'R',
                 local TYPE ty_mode VALUE 'L',
               END OF c_mode.

    " Capture modes for a SUBM step. SUBMIT has no EXPORTING parameters,
    " so a report cannot hand data back on its own - the caller names the
    " mechanism and the wrapper FM applies it.
    CONSTANTS: BEGIN OF c_capture,
                 salv TYPE c LENGTH 10 VALUE 'SALV',
                 list TYPE c LENGTH 10 VALUE 'LIST',
                 memo TYPE c LENGTH 10 VALUE 'MEMO',
                 none TYPE c LENGTH 10 VALUE 'NONE',
               END OF c_capture.

    " The SUBMIT never happens in this session: it is delegated to this
    " RFC-enabled FM over DESTINATION 'NONE' so the report gets its own
    " LUW and cannot corrupt the RAP transaction (L-227).
    CONSTANTS c_submit_fm        TYPE c LENGTH 30 VALUE 'ZFS_RFC_DYNGW_SUBMIT'.
    CONSTANTS c_rfc_dest         TYPE rfcdest VALUE 'NONE'.
    CONSTANTS c_max_rows_default TYPE i       VALUE 100.

    " Call-log rows staged by the actions and written by LSC_DynGateway~save,
    " so the log lands inside RAP's own save sequence and its COMMIT.
    CLASS-DATA gt_log TYPE tt_log.

    "! Formats a ZFS_TRM_MSG message without sending it.
    CLASS-METHODS msg
      IMPORTING iv_number      TYPE symsgno
                iv_v1          TYPE string OPTIONAL
                iv_v2          TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_text) TYPE ty_msgtext.

    "! Builds a failed outcome carrying a catalogued message.
    CLASS-METHODS fail
      IMPORTING iv_number     TYPE symsgno
                iv_v1         TYPE string OPTIONAL
                iv_v2         TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RETURNING VALUE(rs_out) TYPE ty_outcome.

    "! Builds a succeeded outcome carrying message 026.
    CLASS-METHODS succeed
      IMPORTING iv_target     TYPE string
                iv_count      TYPE i DEFAULT 0
      RETURNING VALUE(rs_out) TYPE ty_outcome.

    CLASS-METHODS new_uuid
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_uuid) TYPE sysuuid_x16.

    "! Type descriptor for a DDIC / FUPARAREF type name, but only when that
    "! type can actually be instantiated. A generic type (CLIKE, ANY, C with
    "! no length) describes perfectly well and then cannot be created, so it
    "! can never back a dynamically bound parameter - those come back
    "! unbound and the caller decides whether that is fatal.
    CLASS-METHODS descr_for
      IMPORTING iv_type         TYPE clike
      RETURNING VALUE(ro_descr) TYPE REF TO cl_abap_datadescr.

    "! Top-level keys actually present in a JSON object. Used to bind only
    "! the parameters the caller really sent - passing an unsent optional
    "! parameter as its initial value would change the callee's behaviour.
    CLASS-METHODS json_keys
      IMPORTING iv_json        TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_keys) TYPE tt_name.

    "! Joins tokens into ONE comma-separated row. A dynamic column or
    "! ORDER BY list in strict Open SQL must be comma-separated; one bare
    "! name per row is the classic form and the parser rejects the second
    "! token outright (L-309).
    CLASS-METHODS comma_join
      IMPORTING it_tokens     TYPE tt_name
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_one) TYPE tt_name.

    "! Serialises any data object to compact JSON.
    CLASS-METHODS to_json
      IMPORTING is_data        TYPE any
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_json) TYPE string.

    "! Stamps the five audit fields plus the RAP admin fields. Shared by the
    "! registry CRUD handlers and by the call-log writer, so it lives here
    "! rather than being duplicated in both.
    CLASS-METHODS audit_fields
      CHANGING cs_row TYPE zfs_t_slc_dyngw.

ENDCLASS.


CLASS zcl_fs_slc_gw_base IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD msg.
    " INTO only formats the text, it does not send the message - a MESSAGE
    " that raises is not allowed inside a behaviour class.
    MESSAGE ID c_msgid TYPE 'E' NUMBER iv_number WITH iv_v1 iv_v2 INTO rv_text.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD fail.
    rs_out-status  = c_status-error.
    rs_out-msgno   = iv_number.
    rs_out-msgtext = msg( iv_number = iv_number iv_v1 = iv_v1 iv_v2 = iv_v2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD succeed.
    rs_out-status    = c_status-ok.
    rs_out-msgno     = '026'.
    rs_out-row_count = iv_count.
    rs_out-msgtext   = msg( iv_number = '026'
                            iv_v1     = iv_target
                            iv_v2     = |{ iv_count }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD new_uuid.
    TRY.
        rv_uuid = cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_x16_static( ).
      CATCH cx_uuid_error.
        CLEAR rv_uuid.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD to_json.
    rv_json = /ui2/cl_json=>serialize( data        = is_data
                                       pretty_name = /ui2/cl_json=>pretty_mode-none ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD comma_join.
    DATA lv_all TYPE string.

    LOOP AT it_tokens INTO DATA(lv_t).
      lv_all = COND #( WHEN lv_all IS INITIAL THEN lv_t ELSE |{ lv_all }, { lv_t }| ).
    ENDLOOP.
    IF lv_all IS NOT INITIAL.
      APPEND lv_all TO rt_one.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD descr_for.
    DATA lo_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_typedescr.
    DATA lo_data  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_datadescr.
    DATA lr_probe TYPE REF TO data.
    DATA lv_type  TYPE string.

    lv_type = to_upper( |{ iv_type }| ).
    IF lv_type IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " FUPARAREF records LIKE references against the ABAP system fields as
    " 'SY-...'; the DDIC name of that structure is SYST.
    IF lv_type CP 'SY-*'.
      lv_type = |SYST-{ lv_type+3 }|.
    ENDIF.

    cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name(
      EXPORTING  p_name         = lv_type
      RECEIVING  p_descr_ref    = lo_descr
      EXCEPTIONS type_not_found = 1
                 OTHERS         = 2 ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    TRY.
        lo_data ?= lo_descr.
        " Probe: a generic type describes fine but cannot be instantiated.
        CREATE DATA lr_probe TYPE HANDLE lo_data.
        ro_descr = lo_data.
      CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error cx_sy_create_data_error.
        CLEAR ro_descr.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD json_keys.
    DATA lr_data TYPE REF TO data.
    DATA lo_str  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.

    IF iv_json IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " GENERATE builds a data reference whose components are exactly the
    " JSON's own top-level keys - that is the "was it supplied?" answer.
    " Caught broadly on purpose: this parses caller-supplied text, and a
    " malformed payload must become a message, never a short dump.
    TRY.
        lr_data = /ui2/cl_json=>generate( json = iv_json ).
      CATCH cx_root.
        RETURN.
    ENDTRY.
    IF lr_data IS NOT BOUND.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    TRY.
        lo_str ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref( lr_data ).
      CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error.
        RETURN.
    ENDTRY.

    LOOP AT lo_str->components INTO DATA(ls_comp).
      APPEND to_upper( |{ ls_comp-name }| ) TO rt_keys.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD audit_fields.
    DATA lv_now TYPE timestampl.

    GET TIME STAMP FIELD lv_now.
    cs_row-zchanged_by           = sy-uname.
    cs_row-zchanged_date         = sy-datum.
    cs_row-zchanged_time         = sy-uzeit.
    cs_row-local_last_changed_by = sy-uname.
    cs_row-local_last_changed_at = lv_now.
    cs_row-last_changed_at       = lv_now.
    IF cs_row-zcreated_by IS INITIAL.
      cs_row-zcreated_by      = sy-uname.
      cs_row-zcreated_date    = sy-datum.
      cs_row-zcreated_time    = sy-uzeit.
      cs_row-local_created_by = sy-uname.
      cs_row-local_created_at = lv_now.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.
runtime:
**********************************************************************
* Dynamic gateway - production adapter for the non-clean-core runtime.
*
* Dynamic function calls, dynamic Open SQL and the RFC submit wrapper
* live behind this compatibility seam.
**********************************************************************
CLASS zcl_fs_slc_gw_runtime DEFINITION
  PUBLIC
  FINAL
  CREATE PUBLIC.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_fs_slc_gw_runtime.

ENDCLASS.


CLASS zcl_fs_slc_gw_runtime IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD zif_fs_slc_gw_runtime~call_function.
    TRY.
        IF iv_mode = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>c_mode-rfc.
          CALL FUNCTION iv_name
            DESTINATION zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>c_rfc_dest
            PARAMETER-TABLE ct_params
            EXCEPTION-TABLE ct_exceptions.
        ELSE.
          CALL FUNCTION iv_name
            PARAMETER-TABLE ct_params
            EXCEPTION-TABLE ct_exceptions.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error INTO DATA(call_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION NEW zcx_fs_gw_error(
          textid   = zcx_fs_gw_error=>dynamic_call_failed
          previous = call_error
          iv_v1    = |{ iv_name }|
          iv_v2    = call_error->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.

    rs_result-subrc = sy-subrc.
    rs_result-dbcnt = sy-dbcnt.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0 AND sy-msgid IS NOT INITIAL.
      MESSAGE ID sy-msgid TYPE 'E' NUMBER sy-msgno
        WITH sy-msgv1 sy-msgv2 sy-msgv3 sy-msgv4
        INTO rs_result-message.
    ELSEIF sy-subrc <> 0.
      rs_result-message = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>msg(
        iv_number = '020'
        iv_v1     = CONV string( iv_name )
        iv_v2     = CONV string( sy-subrc ) ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.


  METHOD zif_fs_slc_gw_runtime~select_rows.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <result_rows> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.

    TRY.
        DATA(line_type) = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( is_plan-comp ).
        DATA(table_type) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = line_type ).
        CREATE DATA rr_rows TYPE HANDLE table_type.
      CATCH cx_sy_struct_creation
            cx_sy_table_creation
            cx_sy_create_data_error INTO DATA(type_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION NEW zcx_fs_gw_error(
          textid   = zcx_fs_gw_error=>source_not_found
          previous = type_error
          iv_v1    = is_plan-source ).
    ENDTRY.

    ASSIGN rr_rows->* TO <result_rows>.
    TRY.
        SELECT (is_plan-sel)
          FROM (is_plan-source)
          WHERE (is_plan-where)
          ORDER BY (is_plan-ord)
          INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @<result_rows>
          UP TO @is_plan-max ROWS.
      CATCH cx_sy_dynamic_osql_error INTO DATA(dynamic_sql_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION NEW zcx_fs_gw_error(
