          textid   = zcx_fs_gw_error=>dynamic_call_failed
          previous = dynamic_sql_error
          iv_v1    = is_plan-source
          iv_v2    = dynamic_sql_error->get_text( ) ).
      CATCH cx_sy_open_sql_error INTO DATA(sql_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION NEW zcx_fs_gw_error(
          textid   = zcx_fs_gw_error=>dynamic_call_failed
          previous = sql_error
          iv_v1    = is_plan-source
          iv_v2    = sql_error->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.


  METHOD zif_fs_slc_gw_runtime~modify_rows.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <rows> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.

    ASSIGN is_plan-r_rows->* TO <rows>.
    IF <rows> IS NOT ASSIGNED.
      RAISE EXCEPTION NEW zcx_fs_gw_error(
        textid = zcx_fs_gw_error=>invalid_json
        iv_v1  = 'ImportJson' ).
    ENDIF.

    TRY.
        CASE is_plan-operation.
          WHEN zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>c_op-insert.
            INSERT (is_plan-name) FROM TABLE <rows> ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS.
          WHEN zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>c_op-modify.
            MODIFY (is_plan-name) FROM TABLE <rows>.
          WHEN zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>c_op-delete.
            DELETE (is_plan-name) FROM TABLE <rows>.
          WHEN OTHERS.
            RAISE EXCEPTION NEW zcx_fs_gw_error(
              textid = zcx_fs_gw_error=>operation_not_permitted
              iv_v1  = |{ is_plan-operation }|
              iv_v2  = is_plan-name ).
        ENDCASE.
      CATCH cx_sy_open_sql_error INTO DATA(sql_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION NEW zcx_fs_gw_error(
          textid   = zcx_fs_gw_error=>dynamic_call_failed
          previous = sql_error
          iv_v1    = is_plan-name
          iv_v2    = sql_error->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.

    rs_result-subrc = sy-subrc.
    rs_result-dbcnt = sy-dbcnt.
  ENDMETHOD.


  METHOD zif_fs_slc_gw_runtime~submit_report.
    DATA(selection_parameters) = is_plan-sel.
    DATA rfc_message TYPE c LENGTH 200.

    CALL FUNCTION zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>c_submit_fm
      DESTINATION zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>c_rfc_dest
      EXPORTING
        iv_program            = is_plan-program
        iv_mode               = is_plan-mode
        iv_variant            = is_plan-variant
        iv_memory_id          = is_plan-memory_id
        iv_max_rows           = is_plan-max
      IMPORTING
        ev_status             = rs_result-status
        ev_msgno              = rs_result-msgno
        ev_message            = rs_result-message
        ev_rows_json          = rs_result-rows_json
        ev_export_json        = rs_result-export_json
        ev_count              = rs_result-row_count
      TABLES
        it_selparams          = selection_parameters
      EXCEPTIONS
        system_failure        = 1 MESSAGE rfc_message
        communication_failure = 2 MESSAGE rfc_message
        OTHERS                = 3.

    rs_result-runtime-subrc = sy-subrc.
    rs_result-runtime-dbcnt = sy-dbcnt.
    rs_result-runtime-message = rfc_message.
  ENDMETHOD.


  METHOD zif_fs_slc_gw_runtime~commit_session.
    DATA commit_result TYPE bapiret2.
    DATA rfc_message TYPE c LENGTH 200.

    CALL FUNCTION 'BAPI_TRANSACTION_COMMIT'
      DESTINATION zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>c_rfc_dest
      EXPORTING
        wait                  = abap_true
      IMPORTING
        return                = commit_result
      EXCEPTIONS
        system_failure        = 1 MESSAGE rfc_message
        communication_failure = 2 MESSAGE rfc_message
        OTHERS                = 3.

    rv_ok = xsdbool( sy-subrc = 0 AND commit_result-type CA ' SI' ).
  ENDMETHOD.


  METHOD zif_fs_slc_gw_runtime~rollback_session.
    DATA rfc_message TYPE c LENGTH 200.

    CALL FUNCTION 'BAPI_TRANSACTION_ROLLBACK'
      DESTINATION zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>c_rfc_dest
      EXCEPTIONS
        system_failure        = 1 MESSAGE rfc_message
        communication_failure = 2 MESSAGE rfc_message
        OTHERS                = 3.

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.
log:
**********************************************************************
* Dynamic OData gateway - call log collector.
*
* Owns everything about the call log except the decision to write one:
* payload caps, log levels, the per-step child rows, and the durable
* emit path used when the caller's LUW is about to be rolled back.
*
* WHY THE DURABLE PATH EXISTS
*
* The log row is staged in ZCL_FS_SLC_GW_BASE=>GT_LOG and drained by
* LSC_DynGateway~save, so it lives in the caller's LUW. When a batch
* aborts, the RAP request is failed, that LUW rolls back, and the row
* goes with it - so the one call that most needs explaining is the one
* guaranteed to leave no trace. The old behaviour was to CLEAR the
* staged row outright, on the reasoning that a row describing
* rolled-back work would mislead. That reasoning is sound and the
* consequence was still L-313: an aborted batch answers HTTP 400 with an
* empty body and nothing anywhere says why.
*
* EMIT_DURABLE resolves it rather than trading one fault for the other.
* The rows go out over DESTINATION 'NONE', which is a separate LUW and
* commits independently - the same mechanism, and the same reason, that
* FUNC steps already use it.
*
* NO TEXT IS INVENTED HERE. An earlier draft stamped a literal note on
* the surviving rows saying the work had been rolled back. That is a
* message, and messages come only from ZFS_TRM_MSG (L-210) - so it was
* removed rather than catalogued, because the rows already carry the
* catalogued failure that caused the abort. If an explicit "rolled back"
* marker is wanted it needs a real message number, which is a decision
* for the human and not something to invent here.
*
* NOTHING IS FIXED THAT COULD BE CONFIGURED. The payload cap is a
* parameter with a default, not a buried literal, and whether a row is
* written at all comes from the registry row's LOG_LEVEL rather than
* from this class deciding for everyone.
*
* LOGGING MUST NEVER CHANGE THE OUTCOME. Every emit is wrapped and its
* failure swallowed. A gateway that refused a valid call because its
* audit trail was unavailable would be a worse defect than the one this
* class exists to fix.
*
* PREREQUISITE: ZFS_RFC_DYNGW_LOG must be remote-enabled
* (TFDIR-FMODE = 'R'). That flag cannot be set from ADT or any MCP route
* (L-324) and is maintained by hand in SE37, exactly as it was for
* ZFS_RFC_DYNGW_SUBMIT. Until it is set, EMIT_DURABLE degrades silently
* to a no-op - by design, per the paragraph above.
**********************************************************************
CLASS zcl_fs_slc_gw_log DEFINITION
  PUBLIC
  ABSTRACT
  FINAL.

  PUBLIC SECTION.

    " Which phase a row describes. A batch rejected in validation never
    " executed anything, so every one of its rows is 'P'.
    CONSTANTS: BEGIN OF c_phase,
                 prepare TYPE c LENGTH 1 VALUE 'P',
                 execute TYPE c LENGTH 1 VALUE 'X',
               END OF c_phase.

    " Registry-row log level. Blank is treated as ALL, so every existing
    " row keeps today's behaviour without being migrated.
    CONSTANTS: BEGIN OF c_level,
                 all    TYPE c LENGTH 1 VALUE 'A',
                 errors TYPE c LENGTH 1 VALUE 'E',
                 none   TYPE c LENGTH 1 VALUE 'N',
               END OF c_level.

    " Default payload cap, overridable per call. RESPONSE_JSON holds
    " export + tables + rows concatenated, so an unbounded read was stored
    " in full - once to the caller and once forever.
    CONSTANTS c_max_payload TYPE i VALUE 5000.

    " Called by name, so this class carries no compile-time dependency on
    " the function group - the same pattern as C_SUBMIT_FM.
    CONSTANTS c_log_fm TYPE c LENGTH 30 VALUE 'ZFS_RFC_DYNGW_LOG'.

    "! Truncates to IV_MAX, leaving a visible marker so a reader can tell
    "! truncation from a genuinely short payload.
    CLASS-METHODS cap
      IMPORTING iv_text        TYPE string
                iv_max         TYPE i DEFAULT c_max_payload
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_text) TYPE string.

    "! Does this registry log level want a row for this outcome? Blank
    "! means ALL, so an unmigrated registry row behaves exactly as before.
    CLASS-METHODS level_allows
      IMPORTING iv_level       TYPE clike
                iv_status      TYPE clike
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_flag) TYPE abap_bool.

    "! Applies the caps to a finished log row. A successful QURY does not
    "! store its rows at all: ROW_COUNT already carries the useful fact and
    "! the payload has gone to the caller. Failures keep everything - that
    "! is when it is worth having.
    CLASS-METHODS apply_caps
      IMPORTING iv_max TYPE i DEFAULT c_max_payload
      CHANGING  cs_row TYPE zfs_t_slc_dyngw.

    "! One child row per batch step, correlated to the call row by
    "! PARENT_UUID. Turns "which step failed" from prose inside
    "! RESPONSE_JSON into a column.
    CLASS-METHODS step_rows
      IMPORTING iv_parent        TYPE sysuuid_x16
                it_res           TYPE zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>tt_step_result
                iv_phase1_failed TYPE abap_bool DEFAULT abap_false
                iv_max           TYPE i DEFAULT c_max_payload
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_rows)   TYPE zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>tt_log.

    "! Writes rows in their own LUW, for the abort path. Never raises and
    "! never reports failure: the caller is already failing and must not be
    "! given a second, misleading reason.
    CLASS-METHODS emit_durable
      IMPORTING it_rows TYPE zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>tt_log.

  PROTECTED SECTION.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
ENDCLASS.


CLASS zcl_fs_slc_gw_log IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD cap.
    DATA(lv_len) = strlen( iv_text ).
    IF iv_max <= 0 OR lv_len <= iv_max.
      rv_text = iv_text.
    ELSE.
      rv_text = |{ substring( val = iv_text off = 0 len = iv_max ) }| &&
                |...[truncated { lv_len - iv_max } bytes]|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.


  METHOD level_allows.
    " Blank means ALL, so nothing has to be migrated for the existing rows
    " to behave exactly as they do today.
    CASE iv_level.
      WHEN c_level-none.
        rv_flag = abap_false.
      WHEN c_level-errors.
        rv_flag = xsdbool( iv_status <> zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>c_status-ok ).
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_flag = abap_true.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.


  METHOD apply_caps.
    IF cs_row-exec_status = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>c_status-ok
       AND cs_row-target_kind = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>c_kind-qury.
      CLEAR cs_row-response_json.
    ELSE.
      cs_row-response_json = cap( iv_text = cs_row-response_json iv_max = iv_max ).
    ENDIF.
    cs_row-request_json = cap( iv_text = cs_row-request_json iv_max = iv_max ).
  ENDMETHOD.


  METHOD step_rows.
    DATA ls_row TYPE zfs_t_slc_dyngw.

    LOOP AT it_res INTO DATA(ls_res).
      CLEAR ls_row.
      ls_row-client       = sy-mandt.
      ls_row-uuid         = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>new_uuid( ).
      ls_row-entry_type   = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>c_entry-log.
      ls_row-parent_uuid  = iv_parent.
      ls_row-step_index   = ls_res-step.
      ls_row-target_kind  = ls_res-kind.
      ls_row-target_name  = ls_res-targetname.
      ls_row-operation    = ls_res-operation.
      ls_row-exec_status  = ls_res-execstatus.
      ls_row-message_id   = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>c_msgid.
      ls_row-message_no   = ls_res-messageno.
      ls_row-message_text = ls_res-messagetext.
      ls_row-row_count    = ls_res-resultcount.
      ls_row-duration_ms  = ls_res-durationms.
      ls_row-executed_by  = sy-uname.

      " Nothing ran at all if validation rejected the batch, so every row
      " belongs to the prepare phase - not just the one that was refused.
      ls_row-phase = COND #( WHEN iv_phase1_failed = abap_true
                             THEN c_phase-prepare
                             WHEN ls_res-execstatus = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>c_status-planned
                             THEN c_phase-prepare
                             ELSE c_phase-execute ).

      ls_row-response_json = cap(
        iv_text = |{ ls_res-exportjson }{ ls_res-tablesjson }{ ls_res-rowsjson }|
        iv_max  = iv_max ).

      zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>audit_fields( CHANGING cs_row = ls_row ).
      APPEND ls_row TO rt_rows.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.


  METHOD emit_durable.
    DATA lv_written TYPE i.

    IF it_rows IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Serialised rather than passed as a table: a classic TABLES parameter
    " must be flat, and ZFS_T_SLC_DYNGW carries two string columns. The
    " alternative was a DDIC table type created only to satisfy an RFC
    " signature.
    DATA(lv_json) = zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>to_json( it_rows ).

    " By name over DESTINATION 'NONE', so the write lands in its own LUW
    " and survives the rollback that is about to happen in the caller.
    CALL FUNCTION c_log_fm
      DESTINATION zcl_fs_slc_gw_base=>c_rfc_dest
      EXPORTING
        iv_rows_json          = lv_json
      IMPORTING
        ev_written            = lv_written
      EXCEPTIONS
        system_failure        = 1
        communication_failure = 2
        OTHERS                = 3.

    " Deliberately ignored - see the class header. A failed audit write
    " must never become a second failure reported to a caller who already
    " has one, and this path only ever runs when the request is doomed.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.
